description: EFFICIENT GRAVITY FEED SYSTEM: The EPSG-827A utilizes a top-mounted 600ml gravity feed cup that optimizes fluid flow using gravity. HIGH-PERFORMANCE ATOMIZATION: Engineered for professional results, this spray gun operates at a rated pressure of 3-4 Bar with an air consumption of 170-300 L/min. It delivers a fine, consistent mist that ensures smooth, even coverage, reducing overspray and creating a high-quality finish on surfaces. UNIVERSAL COMPATIBILITY & BUILD: Designed with a standard 1/4" Air Inlet (listed as 1.4" on pack, standard size is 1/4"), this tool connects easily to most standard air compressor hoses. Its durable construction is built to withstand the rigors of daily workshop use while maintaining a lightweight feel to reduce wrist fatigue. VERSATILE PAINTING APPLICATIONS: This multi-purpose tool is perfect for a wide variety of projects. Whether you are refinishing a car, polishing furniture, painting metal gates and grills, or applying topcoats to walls, the EPSG-827A handles primers, enamels, lacquers, and stains with ease. PRECISE CONTROL ADJUSTMENTS: The gun features accessible adjustment knobs that allow users to fine-tune the fluid flow and spray pattern. This level of control enables you to customize the spray width and density to suit the specific object you are painting, from detailed woodwork to broad automotive panels.
